999008199.text:
拠点内にもだいぶものが増えたね！
壁にも色々飾ってさ、もっと楽しくしようよ！

localizations.en: Our base is filling up nicely! Let's make it even more lively by decorating the walls!

999008199.text:
いいわね。それなら……全体的に大人っぽく、
綺麗で上品にまとめない？

localizations.en: That sounds lovely. How about we go for something... sophisticated and elegant throughout?

999008199.text:
あたしはやっぱりかわいいものがいいな！
結局のところ、かわいいは正義なんだよ！

localizations.en: I still say we go with cute things! After all, you can never go wrong with cute!

999008199.text:
おい、ここは自分の家でも遊び場でもねえぞ。
見た目よりも実用性が大事なんじゃねえの

localizations.en: Hey, this isn't your house or a playground. Shouldn't we focus on practicality over appearances?

999008199.text:
話し合いで、私の案に決定ね。
私がこの拠点を、綺麗で上品な形にまとめてみせるわ

localizations.en: They've decided to go with my suggestion. I'll make sure this base exudes elegance and sophistication.

999008199.text: ファンシーな壁の装飾

あたしの案に決まりだね！
あれもこれも飾りたいな～！　うーん、迷う～！

localizations.en: They picked my idea! Ooh, I want to put up all sorts of things! Hmm, so many choices~!

999008199.text: 調査団らしい壁の装飾

っしゃ、オレの案が通ったな。
お前らに、機能美ってモンを教えてやるよ

localizations.en: Ha, they went with my idea. Time to show you all what functional beauty really means.
